caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device consisting of a central vertical support mounted on a small rectangular platform with four angled legs, resembling a short stool or small table. Attached to the vertical support is a rotating horizontal cylindrical piece with six evenly spaced protruding wooden handles radiating outward like spokes on a wheel. In addition, a metal or dark-colored cylindrical component extends horizontally from the center of the wheel. The entire contraption is rendered in shades of brown, highlighting the natural wood grain and texture, while the metallic element contrasts in a darker tone. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or features present.
title: Clock Reel
